SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.user_id, o.product_id, o.quantity, o.total_amount, o.receiver_name, o.receiver_phone, o.delivery_address, o.remark, o.status, o.created_at, p.name AS product_name, p.spec AS product_spec, p.unit AS product_unit, u.nickname AS user_nickname FROM product_order o JOIN product p ON p.id = o.product_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id
ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT p.id AS product_id, p.name AS product_name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity), 0) AS total_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS total_amount FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_order o ON o.product_id = p.id AND o.status <> 'CANCELLED' AND o.created_at >= #{from} AND o.created_at < #{to} GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC, p.id ASC
